name: Lavis (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of blue and red, charged at the centre with a white panel bearing the crowned municipal arms of Lavis (a yellow shell on blue and a white cross on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Lavis, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 9 August 1929.

features.role: Lavis arms — yellow shell on blue above a white cross on red, crowned, within branches
